items.name: Total company record backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: Lockheed Martin reported a record total backlog of $230 billion, inclusive of the multi-year contract to produce THAAD interceptors.
items.source_excerpt: Record backlog of $230 billion, inclusive of the multi-year contract to produce THAAD interceptors

items.name: Missiles and Fire Control segment backlog, June 28 2026
items.claim: Lockheed Martin's Missiles and Fire Control segment, which includes its munitions and missile-replenishment programs, carried backlog of $87,882 million as of June 28, 2026, up from $46,650 million at December 31, 2025.
items.source_excerpt: Backlog June 28, 2026 Dec. 31, 2025 Aeronautics $ 54,356 $ 59,435 Missiles and Fire Control 87,882 46,650 Rotary and Mission Systems 48,454 47,715

notes: Both items sourced from the stored Q2 2026 8-K earnings exhibit (data/edgar/docs/LMT.json). The Missiles and Fire Control segment carries LMT's munitions-adjacent production (THAAD, PAC-3, GMLRS, JASSM, HIMARS); its own backlog line nearly doubled year over year, which is the money-corner detail for the munitions-replenishment chain. value is the source table's own printed number (in millions, per the table header) with currency USD million.
